spec.name: El Allali Juice
spec.description:
Creative juice shop offering multiple detoxx juice variation based on healthy ingredient like Spinash, beats, green apples, celery, carrots and sugar cane juice.

They offer 3 different variations of the juice: Green (Cucumber), Red (beats) and Yellow (carrots) with optional sugar cane juice and ginger.
comments: El Allali is a very nice person, always smilling.
Although the quatity is very good, they often offer you free refills called "Daam".
